name: Myriad Hotel
source:
Take on the role of manager in this visual novel about managing a teleporting hotel in a modern fantasy world. Impress quirky clients, earn money to pay off a pesky loan shark, and help staff work through personal issues. Myriad Hotel is a mostly lighthearted comedy, with a few tense moments sprinkled in for drama.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2279530/]Steam[/url]]
